Enjoy the perfect balance of privacy and convenience in this tucked-away neighborhood setting, while remaining close to shopping, dining, and transportation. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy comfortable townhouse living in a highly desirable location. Subject to seller securing suitable housing (property already identified).
